pages.title: Written on a Napkin
pages.text: Record a nonempty Wok or Stockpot recipe in a Recipe Book.

pages.title: Written on a Napkin
pages.text: A recorded recipe makes a favorite dish easier to repeat.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use a Recipe Book on a suitable station. A real saved recipe is required; clicking an empty pot is insufficient.

pages.title: Record a cooking recipe
pages.text: Record a loaded Wok before stirring or a Stockpot before closing it. Reusing the recipe later transfers suitable ingredients from your inventory.
